{"content": "{\"analyst_interpretation_verified\":false,\"analyst_lesson\":\"A completed earlier patch repaired all literal public ProductSet/FiniteSet examples and relevant public tests, yet its official task remained unresolved. It special-cased the FiniteSet class. Seven independently executed neighboring PUBLIC checks still failed; these are not identified hidden assertions or a verified successful repair.\\n Let a=FiniteSet(1,2), b=ProductSet(a,a), c=FiniteSet((1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)). They are extensionally equal. Both ordinary subset directions should be True and all four proper subset/superset directions should be False. The earlier patch incorrectly returned True for every proper relation: generic methods used structural self != other, which is insufficient for extensional inequality.\\n Replacing b with ProductSet(Range(1,3), Range(1,3)) represents the same four values. The earlier FiniteSet-only implementation left b.is_subset(c) as None, Eq(b,c).simplify() raising the public Complement.equals AttributeError, and b.rewrite(FiniteSet) unchanged. ProductSet already exposes is_finite_set and is_iterable; Range is a different concrete finite iterable representation. Relevant public code: sympy/sets/sets.py subset/proper relations and ProductSet; sympy/sets/handlers/comparison.py equality; fancysets.py Range.\\n Analyst lesson: implement extensional set behavior using justified capabilities and both operand orders, rather than one concrete class or Python structural inequality. For enumeration require known finite and iterable inputs; do not enumerate infinite or unknown sets. Preserve None/unknown symbolic outcomes and use fuzzy logic where appropriate. Test subset/superset, proper relations, equality simplification, intersection symmetry and explicit finite rewrite for alternate representations, equal/unequal sets and symbolic membership. Reproduce and verify the claims in your own checkout; no supplied patch or guarantee of official success.\",\"application_policy\":\"PUBLIC_DIAGNOSTIC_HYPOTHESES_REPRODUCE_AND_VALIDATE_CURRENT_CHECKOUT\",\"kind\":\"public_failure_diagnostic_interpretation\",\"probe_expectations\":\"ANALYST_SELECTED_PUBLIC_EXPECTATIONS_NOT_A_BENCHMARK_ORACLE\",\"public_probe\":{\"base_observation_sha256\":\"588ea09e3df86e5c70eb83c2871d12c6a6700c26f26192201a17b254e7a11b7c\",\"baseline_passed\":2,\"created_utc\":\"2026-09-13T02:23:52.578626+00:00\",\"probe_source_sha256\":\"8a8128cb84cae4994897b119698a594ae5f52a352a2fe947b242f6320e25dbdd\",\"residual_public_cases\":[\"equal_representations_not_proper_subset\",\"equal_representations_not_proper_superset\",\"equal_representations_reverse_not_proper_subset\",\"equal_representations_reverse_not_proper_superset\",\"finite_range_product_subset_explicit\",\"finite_range_product_equal_explicit\",\"finite_range_product_rewrite\"],\"submitted_observation_sha256\":\"9c70d890fc4ff25c0a3ae7f73efb262147c5b92f81ffa45b3891f5fa226b12d0\",\"submitted_passed\":5,\"total\":12},\"public_probe_evidence_sha256\":\"41262bce2a86a70b255bc96c781fed4755045aa29133ce4b104acc8ff066155a\",\"repository\":\"sympy/sympy\",\"scenario\":\"KNOWN_FAILURE_RECOVERY\",\"source_evidence_label\":\"PUBLIC_DIAGNOSTIC_INTERPRETATION_OF_COMPLETED_FAILURES\",\"source_official_resolved\":false,\"source_public_result_sha256\":\"46441a22b037811aaf172dcdae29e5a445291939d3f24968fbdae346be3614d6\",\"source_revision\":\"33b47e4bd60e2302e42616141e76285038b724d6\",\"source_task_id\":\"swebench_verified--sympy__sympy-20438\",\"submitted_patch_sha256\":\"a8e5bc4748fff9c6938cff63ea5ab5db6dc6a51812993f774b3b44d3ec262492\",\"target_fix_verified\":false,\"verified_skill\":false}", "layer": "REPOSITORY_SEMANTIC", "revision": "33b47e4bd60e2302e42616141e76285038b724d6", "title": "Public failure diagnostic: Extensional set equality, ProductSet finite iteration, Range and proper subset semantics"}
